children: New Delhi: NMDC Ltd has recovered a 27.29-carat gem-quality diamond from its Diamond Mining Project (DMP) in Panna, Madhya Pradesh, making it the second-largest diamond recovered from the NMDC Panna mine, a company statement said. "The diamond was recovered on Tuesday.

The largest diamond recovered from NMDC's Panna mine so far was a 34.37-carat gem-quality diamond discovered in 2010, which was subsequently sold for 3.2 crore," NMDC said. Based on its colour, carat weight, clarity and S-shape, the newly recovered diamond is initially estimated to be valued at around 1 crore. The final value will be determined through the evaluation and auction process, the company added.

title: 27.29-Carat Diamond Found in Panna Mine
